digest.component_or_area: module size governance and code organization
propositions: Six files in the codebase sit within 7 lines of the 800 LOC module-size cap, with three at exactly 800 LOC, blocking forward work.
llm/config.py has only 7 lines of headroom against the cap despite being the highest-centrality file (fan-in 93), and cannot accommodate new config knobs that each require 10-16 lines.

Module-level refactoring following ADR 0056's pattern (extract absorbing verbs, flatten declaration tables, split colocated domains) can relieve high-churn, near-capacity files before dependent work discovers the breach.
Seam tests asserting per-file headroom targets and STEP_REGISTRY membership serve as a structural substitute for the declined per-function length gate, protecting against future regrowth.

Four child tickets extracted config.py to 631 LOC, workflow_ops.py to 511 LOC, created gate_context.py and decide_ops.py, and established headroom guards, enabling d23e to land a deprecation alias without structural prerequisite.
